maria (partnerships): Heads-up — LangChain wants to run a joint demo tour with SigmaCompute (HW partner) + our gateway path next month. Can we sync on checklist and embargo windows?
aj (eng): +1. We need a QA env that mirrors Dedicated perf (batching + cache). Who owns infra?
kevin (devex): I can stand up a demo cluster in the sandbox region. Need the model + quant profile and example prompts.
tom (product): Goals: 1) show low-latency routing to gateway->redwood runtime, 2) seamless LangChain chains calling our function/tooling, 3) HW perf callouts.
jen (marketing): Also need co-branded assets, one-pager, short demo script, and a press embargo date. Tentative window: week of Apr 19.
maria (partnerships): @aj can you confirm SSO/keys for SigmaCompute engineers and LangChain devs? We need access by Apr 8 for dry runs.
aj (eng): I’ll generate scoped API keys and demo service accounts. Security note: no prod keys — limited to demo models and 24h TTL.
partner-bot: SigmaCompute repo access granted to: sara-sigma, lee-sigma (audit log link: https://internal.redwood/links/si-access) :white_check_mark:
kevin (devex): For the demo cluster, please drop the exact model ref and quant flag here. Example config I need:
```yaml
model: gpt-open-median-v2
quant: int8
batching: burst-32
cache: prefix-enabled
```
jen (marketing): Co-marketing asks: logo tiles, joint quote, 60s demo video, and a co-hosted blog post. Legal needs 72h to review any quote.
maria (partnerships): Legal sync scheduled Fri 10am. Action items: Aj -> demo keys, Kevin -> cluster, Tom -> script + failure fallback (plan B), Jen -> assets + embargo.
aj (eng): Noted. Also need to validate fallback: route to smaller model variant if Sigma nodes overloaded. I’ll add an autoscale policy stub.
tom (product): Demo script draft (first pass):
1) user asks via LangChain app -> call sequence shows gateway routing -> redwood runtime -> Sigma GPU node -> return.
2) inject load to show fallback to CPU-resident variant.
3) show latency and cost meter in console.
Please comment: https://docs.redwood/demo-scripts/demo-1749
kevin (devex): Requesting sample prompt set + 2 long-form and 3 short-form cases. Drop them here and I’ll pre-cache.
maria (partnerships): @jen what's the embargo date you can commit to?
jen (marketing): We can target Apr 22 embargo with coordinated social + blog on Apr 23. Need legal signoff by Apr 19 COB.
partner-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing preflight checklist due Apr 12 (billing SKU, pricing, legal tags).
aJ (typo fix): @aj (eng) — added pricing tags to the marketplace PR for review.
aj (eng): Thanks — will review the PR today.
maria (partnerships): One more: can Sigma provide a demo image and quickstart for customers? That helps the marketplace listing. I’ll ask them for a 1-page install + container.
kevin (devex): If Sigma provides image, I’ll validate startup time and mount points. We should record boot-to-ready for the demo (target <90s).
tom (product): Risk register: 1) embargo leak, 2) perf variability, 3) SSO access issues, 4) marketplace billing mapping. Assign owners?
maria (partnerships): Assign: Jen -> embargo/marketing, Aj -> SSO/keys & fallback, Kevin -> demo infra, Tom -> script/failures, Maria -> partner comms & last-mile coordination.
jen (marketing): I’ll draft the co-hosted blog outline by Apr 10.
aj (eng): I’ll prepare a quick rollback command for the demo in case of performance regressions: `redwood rollback --cluster demo --model gpt-open-median-v2:stable`
kevin (devex): Dry run schedule proposal: Apr 13 internal, Apr 17 partner-dress rehearsal, Apr 20 final smoke run. All times 10am PT. OK?
maria (partnerships): OK to proceed. If anyone can’t make the dry run dates, ping here. Thanks everyone :rocket:
